scripts.demo:offline: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js demo --profile simulated
scripts.serve: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js serve
scripts.attach: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js attach
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js doctor
scripts.trace:export: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js trace:export
scripts.trace:replay: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js trace:replay
scripts.bridge:protocol: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js bridge --mode fixture --config configs/simulated.json
scripts.bridge:fixture: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js bridge --mode fixture --config configs/client-offline.example.json
scripts.test:v:offline: npm run test:integration:offline && npm run test:soak:offline && npm run test:trace:offline
scripts.test:web:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:web && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
scripts.demo:autonomy: npm run build && node dist/cli/main.js demo --scenario autonomous
